correct_sentence: In 1690, just after England forced out one king and installed another on its terms, Locke argued that power comes from the people, which is why later revolutionaries used his ideas to overthrow rulers who broke the deal.
hints: Locke published the year after England replaced its king.
The storming of the Bastille was 1789, a hundred years later.
rationale: Locke wrote in 1690 to justify England's replacement of one king with another. A century later, revolutionaries in France and beyond picked up his argument.
